note: Reviewed exceptions to scripts/check_client_data.py. Every entry is a place the guard is deliberately blind, so the list is capped (see max_entries) and every entry expires. Entries are keyed on the sha256 of the MATCHED LINE, not its number: an entry survives unrelated edits above it and evaporates the moment that line's content changes, so a location cannot be allowlisted and later refilled with something else. A stale or expired entry fails the build rather than quietly continuing to suppress.
